item.title: In Anticipation of Valentines Day | Clergy Corner
item.description: Valentine’s Day cometh - or as my high school student reminded me: the day before Singles Awareness Day. Haha. In spite of the red and pink hearts everywhere, up-charged roses, and impossible-to-get dinner reservations, I know a fair number of people who can’t stand Valentine’s Day.

item.title: Letter to the editor: The Ukranian Children
item.description: Ukraine and the Yale School of Public Health have documented 35,000 abducted Ukrainian children by Russia. Additionally, 1.7 million children live under Russian occupation in eastern Ukraine.
